name: Chapel Blackspire
title: Chapel Blackspire
summary: Chapel Blackspire is the open-air church south of Cragstone where Thorsten Cragstone's funeral was held. In the kit it is a quiet meadow (z 22) with ten wooden pews in two columns facing north-north-east toward an altar group (wooden pedestal, golden candelabrum, black stone column and block) and, 9 m behind the altar, a 20 m dark spire (the 'black spire'); scattered trees around, the shallow sea 200 m to the north-east.

landmarks.name: Pews
landmarks.note: Ten 0x02000120 benches in two columns, rows y 29052-29061.

shots.standingOrder: Lock off 2 m above the grass just behind the last pew, 25 m south-south-west of the black spire, and tilt from the altar up the spire to the sky; nothing passes the lens, keep 2.5 m from the pews.
shots.notes: The outdoor church where Thorsten Cragstone's funeral was held: ten wooden pews in two columns face an altar group (pedestal, golden candelabrum, stone column) and the 20 m dark spire behind it. A locked tilt from pew-and-altar level up the full height of the spire, warm 0.68 afternoon light from the right-behind. Camera at (35581.1, 29048.9, 23.9), pitch +1 -> +21 deg.
